scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Event Grid 操作场景：创建主题 → 列出订阅 → 发布事件 → 删除
commands: az eventgrid topic create --name test-topic --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az eventgrid topic show --name test-topic --resource-group test-rg
az eventgrid topic delete --name test-topic --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：主题创建成功但订阅列表失败
commands: az eventgrid topic create --name fail-topic --resource-group test-rg --location eastus

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：主题不存在
commands: az eventgrid topic show --name nonexistent-topic --resource-group test-rg
